title: Waiver of Premium Rider Specifications for Whole Life Insurance
content:
The waiver of premium rider may be attached to a Whole Life Insurance policy only on the tiers marked available below. The issue-age ceiling, the attained age at whose anniversary the rider ends, and the elimination period of continuous total disability are the same wherever the rider is available.

| Tier | Rider may be attached | Highest issue age for the rider | Rider ends on the anniversary at attained age | Continuous total disability required before premiums are waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | No | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | Yes | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | Yes | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | Yes | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | Yes | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | No | 55 | 65 | 6 calendar months |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- An insured issued at age 55 on a Paid-Up at 100 policy is within the rider's issue ages; one issued at 56 is not.
- The rider ends on the policy anniversary at attained age 65.
- A disability beginning on April 10 completes the 6-month elimination period on October 10.
